extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) lowercase variants in the 'island' column (e.g., 'torgersen', 'dream') were merged into the canonical labels; (2) three rows with invalid flipper lengths (negative values) were excluded as they were out of the expected range (170–235 mm); (3) the 'sex' column had missing values, but they were not relevant to the question. After these fixes, the average bill length by island for Adelie penguins was computed as: Biscoe: 38.86 mm, Dream: 39.18 mm, Torgersen: 37.58 mm.
